scripts.test:tz: rc=0; for tz in Asia/Dhaka America/New_York; do echo "== TZ=$tz"; TZ=$tz pnpm --filter @vesta/shared test || rc=1; TZ=$tz pnpm --filter @vesta/web backend:test || rc=1; done; exit $rc
scripts.ops:test: python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/monitoring/container-metrics-exporter && bash ops/deploy/scripts/test-install-vesta-crontab.sh && bash ops/deploy/scripts/test-check-prod-env.sh
scripts.docker:monitoring: docker compose -f ops/docker/compose.yml -f ops/monitoring/compose.yml -f ops/monitoring/compose.local.override.yml up -d
scripts.docker:monitoring:down: docker compose -f ops/docker/compose.yml -f ops/monitoring/compose.yml -f ops/monitoring/compose.local.override.yml down
scripts.docker:prod:build: docker compose -f ops/deploy/compose.prod.yml build web admin
